# eva

A simple calculator REPL (read–eval–print loop) similar to bc(1), with syntax highlighting and persistent history.

Description

Type an expression and press Enter; the result will be printed. Repeat to continue using the REPL.

Usage

    eva [OPTIONS] [INPUT]

ARGS:
    <INPUT>    Optional expression string to run eva in command mode

OPTIONS:
    -b, --base <RADIX>    Radix of calculation output (1 - 36) [default: 10]
    -f, --fix <FIX>       Number of decimal places in output (1 - 64) [default: 10]
    -r, --radian          Use radian mode
    -h, --help            Print help information
    -V, --version         Print version information

Examples

    > 1 + sin(30)
    1.5

    > floor(sqrt(3^2 + 5^2))
    5

Operators

- Binary operators: +  -  *  /  ^  **
- Unary operators: +  -

Constants

Some mathematical constants are available (for example: pi, e).

Functions

Most common mathematical functions are available. Trigonometric functions accept input in degrees by default.

1-argument functions:

sin, cos, tan, csc, sec, cot, sinh, cosh, tanh, asin, acos, atan, acsc, asec, acot, ln, log2, log10, sqrt, ceil, floor, abs

2-argument functions:

log (base-specific), nroot

Quality of life features

- Auto insertion of implicit multiplication (e.g. 12sin(45) -> 12 * sin(45))
- Auto-balancing of parentheses
- Use previous answer with the underscore (_) symbol
- Friendly error messages for domain errors and syntax issues

</output>
